name: Rising Heat of Stone and Sand
setup: Put 2 Presence on your starting board, in the highest-numbered Sands. You start with your 4 Unique Power Cards and 0 Energy.
playstyle: Weaken-and-Destroy. Likes having {{sacredsite}} where there's Town/City, as it makes all Spirits' Damage more effective there. Has an easier time setting up {{sacredsite}} in Sands and Mountains, but can do so in any terrain with a bit more time.
special_rules: BLISTERING HEAT At your {{sacredsite}}, Invaders have -1 Health (min. 1).
